svg.aria-label: Cumulative regret curves. Greedy climbs in a straight line; epsilon-greedy also grows linearly but slowly; UCB1 and Thompson sampling bend over, Thompson lowest. On a log x-axis epsilon-greedy eventually overtakes UCB1
